nodes.description: Constructor of SPUMEToken: mints initialSupply to msg.sender via _mint and grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to msg.sender via _setupRole.
Public snapshot() function; requires caller to hold SNAPSHOT_ROLE then calls internal _snapshot().
Internal snapshot creation: increments _currentSnapshotId counter, reads current id, emits Snapshot event and returns the id.
Writes a new snapshot entry (ids/values push) when the last stored snapshot id is smaller than the current id.
Overridden hook executed before every mint/burn/transfer; updates account and total supply snapshots.
Public ERC20 transfer that forwards to the internal _transfer using _msgSender() as sender.
Public ERC20 transferFrom: moves tokens, then reduces the caller allowance inside an unchecked block.
Internal transfer: validates addresses, calls _beforeTokenTransfer hook, updates _balances and emits Transfer, then calls _afterTokenTransfer.
Internal mint: increases _totalSupply and recipient balance, emits Transfer from address(0).
Internal burn: decreases account balance (unchecked) and _totalSupply, emits Transfer to address(0).
Increases the caller allowance for a spender by addedValue through _approve.
Decreases the caller allowance for a spender; performs an unchecked subtraction after a require check.
Internal allowance setter: validates owner/spender, writes _allowances and emits Approval.
Reads _roles[role].members[account] to decide whether an account holds a role.
Internal role check that reverts with a formatted message when the account lacks the role.
Grants a role to an account, guarded by the onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)) modifier.
Revokes a role from an account, guarded by the onlyRole(getRoleAdmin(role)) modifier.
Allows the caller to renounce its own role; requires account == _msgSender().
Internal unrestricted role grant: writes _roles[role].members[account] = true and emits RoleGranted.
Internal unrestricted role revocation: writes _roles[role].members[account] = false and emits RoleRevoked.
Internal role setup without caller checks; delegates to _grantRole (used from the constructor).
Internal setter for the admin role of a role; writes _roles[role].adminRole and emits RoleAdminChanged.
Modifier that calls _checkRole(role, _msgSender()) before executing the guarded function body.
Internal helper returning msg.sender as the effective execution context sender.
Private snapshot lookup: validates the snapshot id and binary-searches the ids array for the stored value.
Library function that increments the counter value inside an unchecked block.
Binary search over a sorted uint256[] returning the first index with a value greater than or equal to element.
Public view returning the snapshotted balance of an account at a given snapshot id.
Public view returning the snapshotted total supply at a given snapshot id.
mapping(bytes32 => RoleData) storing role members and admin role for each role.
bytes32 public constant SNAPSHOT_ROLE = keccak256("SNAPSHOT_ROLE") used to gate the snapshot() function.
mapping(address => Snapshots) holding historical balance ids/values per account.
Snapshots struct holding historical total supply ids/values.
Counters.Counter tracking the monotonically increasing snapshot id, starting at 1.
mapping(address => uint256) of token balances, mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of allowances, written by _approve.
Total token supply, increased in _mint and decreased in _burn.
Caller-controlled address used for role checks, minting and allowance bookkeeping.
unchecked { counter._value += 1; } in Counters.increment bypasses overflow protection.
unchecked { _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount; } in _transfer (and _burn) performs unchecked balance arithmetic.
unchecked allowance reduction (currentAllowance - amount / currentAllowance - subtractedValue) performed after a require check.
_balances[recipient] += amount (and _balances[account] += amount in _mint) mutates balances with arithmetic.
_totalSupply += amount in _mint and _totalSupply -= amount in _burn update the supply.
snapshots.ids.push(currentId) and snapshots.values.push(currentValue) append to snapshot storage arrays.
uint256 initialSupply constructor argument minted to the deployer.
bytes32 role identifier passed to hasRole, _checkRole, grantRole and revokeRole.
address account argument of hasRole, _checkRole, grantRole, revokeRole and renounceRole.
address sender argument of ERC20._transfer (source of the balance).
address recipient argument of transfer/_transfer (destination of the balance).
uint256 amount argument of transfer/transferFrom/_transfer/_mint/_burn.
bytes32 adminRole argument of _setRoleAdmin.
uint256 snapshotId argument of _valueAt, balanceOfAt and totalSupplyAt.
address spender argument of approve/_approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance.
address from argument of the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
address to argument of the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
uint256 currentAllowance local in transferFrom/decreaseAllowance holding the pre-subtraction allowance.
uint256 senderBalance local in _transfer holding the sender balance before subtraction.
uint256 currentId local in _updateSnapshot holding the current snapshot id.
uint256 index local in _valueAt holding the binary-search result.
uint256 currentValue local in _updateSnapshot holding the value to snapshot.

normalization_plan.reason: The initialSupply parameter only exists to parameterize the constructor mint flow.
The role parameter is only meaningful as the key of the hasRole membership lookup.
The account parameter is only meaningful as the subject of the hasRole membership lookup.
The sender parameter only exists to identify the source account inside _transfer.
The recipient parameter only exists to identify the destination account inside _transfer.
The amount parameter only exists to size the balance mutation inside _transfer.
The adminRole parameter is consumed solely by _setRoleAdmin.
The snapshotId parameter is consumed solely by the _valueAt lookup.
The spender parameter is consumed solely by _approve when writing _allowances.
The from parameter is consumed solely by the snapshot hook branching.
The to parameter is consumed solely by the snapshot hook branching.
The currentAllowance local is a temporary holder inside transferFrom's allowance reduction.
The senderBalance local is a temporary holder inside _transfer's balance arithmetic.
The currentId local is a temporary holder inside _updateSnapshot's array push.
The index local is a temporary holder of the findUpperBound result inside _valueAt.
The currentValue local is the value written by _updateSnapshot into snapshot storage.
